landing.hero_subtitle: The all-in-one digital agriculture management platform built for Indian farmers to reduce workload, optimize expenses, and boost crop productivity.
landing.features_desc: Manage land, crops, finances, weather, mandi market rates, and AI advisory from one seamless interface.
landing.feat_farm_desc: Multi-farm and acreage breakdown with soil and irrigation types.
landing.feat_crop_desc: From land prep to sowing, growth, flowering, and harvesting records.
landing.feat_finance_desc: Track every rupee from seeds to labour wages with net profit analytics.
landing.feat_weather_desc: Real-time rainfall probability, temperature, humidity, and agronomy advice.
landing.feat_mandi_desc: Real-time prices and market trends from major APMC mandis.
landing.feat_ai_desc: Plant disease diagnosis, voice queries in Marathi/Hindi, and 24/7 expert advice.
landing.step1_desc: Enter your farm name, total acreage, and soil profile.
landing.step2_desc: Record crop varieties, sowing dates, and growth stages.
landing.step3_desc: Log fertilizers, worker wages, irrigation schedules, and daily tasks.
landing.step4_desc: Track APMC mandi prices, follow weather alerts, and maximize yield.
landing.benefit1: Save time and eliminate paper record keeping
landing.benefit2: Prevent over-fertilization and save input costs
landing.benefit3: Early detection of pests and leaf diseases
landing.benefit4: Intuitive mobile-first design in your mother tongue
landing.contact_desc: Have questions? We are always ready to help Indian farmers prosper.

inputs.safety_guideline_desc: Always follow approved dosage instructions specified on CIBRC registered manufacturer labels and state agricultural university bulletins. Wear protective PPE (face mask, rubber gloves, apron). Never spray against strong winds.

ai.subtitle: Ask in Marathi, Hindi, or English, upload leaf photos for disease diagnosis, and get instant guidance

ai.disclaimer: Notice: This is AI-assisted preliminary guidance. For large scale treatment, consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture Extension Officer.
